evidence_against.quote: Consequently, an own-link loss is neither a global service-loss certificate nor evidence that the preceding own action caused harm.

verdict_text: **The final direction decision is to continue with this single bounded native comparison, with the inherited quarter-unit condition explicitly in episode-sum units and the separate 0.01 J MEI retained.** The scientific reason is the now-concrete legal information/action path against credible controls; the uncertainty is whether selective correction has any net value once interference, handoffs, fixed handling and generic learning are allowed to explain the outcome. The answer authorizes only this scoped direction conclusion and its delivery, not scientific execution.
